plan.title: Single-stage RFP required and optional T&C acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow the buyer to add a vendor during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFP.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available questionnaire template.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Fill the required questionnaire fields on the RFP create screen.
Assign an evaluator so the RFP can be published.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set the first clause to Required and leave the second clause as None, click Done, and stop with the saved clause configuration visible

steps.note: Configure the event-wise and stage-wise clauses, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Commit the 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured RFP event.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's RFP questionnaire in the vendor portal.
Accept the required clause.
Accept the optional clause as well.
Attempt to submit the vendor's technical response after accepting both clauses.
Verify that the vendor response was submitted.
